name: Strike Graph
summary: Strike Graph is the only product here with a published price list. Launch is free, Scale starts at $21,500 a year and Enterprise starts at $35,000 a year, with extra frameworks at $2,000 to $8,000 a year. It works with any auditor and can introduce partner auditors.

evidence.capability: framework templates such as soc 2 and iso 27001

facts.text: The free Launch plan includes the SOC 2 security trust services criteria, limited policy templates and one user manager.
SOC 2 is listed as a Tier 1 framework and ISO 27001 as a Tier 2 framework, which sets the price of each extra framework.
Strike Graph says its platform is compatible for any auditor to use, and it can connect customers with vetted independent auditors through its partner network.
Audit fees are set by the independent auditor. Strike Graph's own assessment and audit services for approved certifications are listed at $4,000 to $8,000 a year depending on plan.
The Certify plan shows a free trial button but no price, and Enterprise evidence API access is listed under the Enterprise plan.

hiddenCosts: Additional frameworks cost $2,000 to $8,000 a year depending on plan and tier.
A penetration test costs $10,000 on paid plans, and an enhanced one costs $20,000.
ISO 27001 internal audit costs $8,000 a year on Certify and $7,000 on Scale and Enterprise.
Independent audit fees are set by the auditor and are separate.
Multiple managers require a paid plan.
